Hi Diane,

Thanks again for taking the time last week to walk through Orion's Q3 ramp. - Confirm acceptance of the capacity supplement for July pilot month (1.2x baseline).
- Agree to the revised rate ladder in Section 2 — Karthik is copied for pricing detail.

Attachments: Orion_Addendum_v3_redline.docx (redline), capacity_usage_estimate.xlsx (workload forecast).

If it's helpful, we can route a DocuSign envelope once procurement confirms the PO path.

Hi all —

Attached is a quick delta table (sheet 2 in capacity_usage_estimate.xlsx) that shows the incremental monthly spend under the proposed rate ladder vs current. Summary: the July pilot supplement increases July run-rate by ~18% (one month only) and thereafter the new throughput band reduces per-token unit price for volumes above 10M tokens/month (we've highlighted the break-even guidance for 3, 6, 12 month horizons).

On the contingent credit: we can offer a one-time credit up to $12,000 if measured July baseline is below the forecasted utilization by more than 15%. This is limited to the pilot supplement and documented in Section 5 of the addendum.

If that matches procurement needs, Marissa — feel free to forward the delta table and I can prep a DocuSign envelope for the addendum+orderform once legal signs off.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer

Diane / Marissa —

Thanks — reviewed the redline. Two small legal asks that should keep this moving:

1) Failover wording: replace the current sentence in Section 4.2 with: "Customer traffic may be routed to a compatible Redwood model variant in another region only after prior notice and where Customer's data isolation controls are preserved as described in Exhibit B."

2) Audit logs / telemetry retention: procurement asked for daily telemetry; we will provide daily telemetry for the pilot month but we propose a 30-day retention window for the telemetry we push to Customer (longer retention can be scoped via an add-on).

I have annotated the redline and removed a couple of open-form clauses that procurement's legal team might flag. If those two edits are OK, we can consider this final and Karthik can route DocuSign.

Regards,
